title: Validation metrics: choose with the right question

steps.label: Three candidate classifiers
steps.python:
models = {'A': (0.92, 0.70, 0.95), 'B': (0.91, 0.86, 0.80), 'C': (0.94, 0.95, 0.45)}   # accuracy, precision, recall
for name, (acc, p, r) in models.items():
    print(name, acc, p, r)
# prints: A 0.92 0.7 0.95
# prints: B 0.91 0.86 0.8
# prints: C 0.94 0.95 0.45

steps.label: View: accuracy
steps.pseudocode: Which model has the best accuracy?
steps.python:
models = {'A': (0.92, 0.70, 0.95), 'B': (0.91, 0.86, 0.80), 'C': (0.94, 0.95, 0.45)}   # accuracy, precision, recall
print(max(models, key=lambda k: models[k][0]))
# prints: C

steps.label: Choose the metric first

steps.python:
steps = ['understand the cost of each mistake', 'pick the metric', 'compare models on validation data']
for s in steps:
    print(s)

steps.label: Select the model
steps.pseudocode: Select the model with the best validation recall.
steps.python:
models = {'A': (0.92, 0.70, 0.95), 'B': (0.91, 0.86, 0.80), 'C': (0.94, 0.95, 0.45)}   # accuracy, precision, recall
print(max(models, key=lambda k: models[k][2]), 'selected on validation data')
# prints: A selected on validation data
